title: Hayi!
description: Intombazana ethile encinci inomkhwa wokuthi ‘Hayi’. Usoloko esitsho rhoqo. Eneneni, ngalo lonke ixesha. Ngenye imini nakuba kunjalo, ujongana nombuzo omhenda kakhulu aze angakwazi kuzinceda kodwa athi ‘EWE’!

usagePolicy.reason: The complete illustrated edition and editable source files remain at Book Dash; this local entry preserves discovery and creator attribution.
